groups.title: Engineering Courses
groups.intro: Day-by-day courses with a live lab, worked example and quiz every day, and a certificate at the end.

items.name: SolidWorks Course
items.title: SolidWorks Course
items.blurb: Part I, 28 days from the first sketch to drawings, GD&T, weldments and simulation. Part II, 14 days on documentation and automation: macros, PDM, MBD, costing and rendering.

items.name: Creo Course
items.title: Creo Parametric Course
items.blurb: The same format for PTC Creo: Sketcher, features, relations, family tables, assemblies, Mechanism, sheetmetal, drawings, surfacing and Simulate, with a SolidWorks → Creo command map.

items.name: Machine Design Course
items.title: Machine Design Course
items.blurb: Design of machine elements from first principles to a two-stage gearbox: failure theories, fatigue, fits, joints, shafts, springs, gears, bearings and cost.

items.name: Differential Equations
items.title: Differential Equations, Part I
items.blurb: A visual course: slope fields, stability, numerical methods, vibration and resonance, Laplace, phase planes, chaos, Fourier and PDEs, fitting models to data.

items.name: DE Part II
items.title: Differential Equations, Part II: 100 Equations That Run the World
items.blurb: The atlas that follows Part I: the hundred most useful equations across mechanics, structures, heat, fluids, circuits, fields, flight, biology and finance, each with worked examples and a live lab.

items.name: Manufacturing Course
items.title: Manufacturing Course
items.blurb: How a factory works and how to make it better, for engineers and managers: flow, capacity, OEE, planning, quality, lean, TPM, costing and KPIs, with a flexible packaging plant as the running example.

items.name: Stock Management Course
items.title: Stock Management Crash Course
items.blurb: Materials and stock types, demand and forecasting, lead time, reorder points, safety stock and the everyday terms of stores and inventory control.

groups.title: Tools & Technical Writing
groups.intro: Browser tools that work offline, referenced technical papers, and the history of software.

items.name: Tools
items.title: Tools
items.blurb: Interactive pages that run in your browser and work offline: spring, PSD and bearing calculators, rotor balancing, GD&T, business sim games, word and card games, AstroExplorer and more.

items.name: Papers & Articles
items.title: Technical Papers & Articles
items.blurb: Referenced reviews and engineering articles with worked analysis, plots and code: exoskeletons, blown film, gravure, heat sealing, company histories and more.

items.name: Software History
items.title: Software Through the Ages
items.blurb: Landmark programs from MS-DOS to AI agents: the need behind each one, the technology inside, its rivals and what replaced it.
items.meta: 7 seasons · 39 episodes · by topic or A–Z

groups.title: Business & Finance
groups.intro: Economics, business and management, explained in layers and through the best books.

items.name: Finance & Economics
items.title: Finance & Economics
items.blurb: One idea, three levels: inflation, interest, GDP, banking, taxes, markets, trade, pensions, gold and crypto, for school students, working people and experts.

items.name: Business Admin
items.title: Business Administration
items.blurb: Fifty chapters in three levels, from what a business is to accounting, ratios, management accounting, finance and strategy.

items.name: Book Review
items.title: Management Book Review
items.blurb: One famous management book a day: a 300-word summary, the key ideas and ten questions, with a certificate.

groups.title: Reading & Reflections
groups.intro: Essays, book reviews on life and family, Zen stories, and films and TV.

items.name: Speaks
items.title: Vijay Anand Speaks
items.blurb: Short essays on life, family, relationships, work and leadership, in English and Tamil, written since 2009.

items.name: Life Books
items.title: Life Books
items.blurb: One well-loved book a night on personal growth, family, love and raising children: a summary, ten questions and a certificate.

items.name: Zen Series
items.title: Zen Series
items.blurb: Small stories, still minds: a short Zen tale with a reflection and a thought to carry into the day.

items.name: Movie & TV Review
items.title: Movie & TV Review
items.blurb: Tamil and English films and TV series: plot, crew, music, the technology behind them, box office and an emotional review.

groups.title: Study Explorers
groups.intro: Interactive study pages for school and law students, with animations, practice and certificates.

items.name: Class VIII Study
items.title: Class VIII Study Explorers
items.blurb: CBSE / NCERT Class VIII: Maths (Ganita Prakash 2026 and CBSE), Science, Social Science and Direct & Indirect Speech.

items.name: Law Study
items.title: Law Study Explorers
items.blurb: B.Com. LL.B. (Hons.) Semester I: Legal Methods, Torts, Accounting & Auditing, Business Organisation, Sociology and Business English.
